metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Matches the highly optimistic, ensemble-led charm and workplace comedy format of Ted Lasso and Community.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A high-energy, comforting workplace comedy with a lovable ensemble cast and the same heartfelt silliness found in Scrubs.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A heartwarming, quirky animated family sitcom that fans of wholesome cartoon humor like King of the Hill and The Simpsons will love.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This legendary British comedy bridges the gap between the tech satire of Silicon Valley and classic dry UK humor like Peep Show.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: An iconic UK teen comedy with the same chaotic, cringe-inducing energy and sharp banter as Peep Show and PhoneShop.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: Directed by Edgar Wright, this pop-culture-obsessed UK comedy is perfect for fans who appreciate the meta-humor and film parodies in Community.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A fast-paced, nostalgic, and incredibly funny coming-of-age comedy with a brilliantly eccentric cast of characters.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary about vampires that blends the chaotic group dynamic of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia with supernatural elements.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: A highly-rated, brilliantly structured sitcom with dense joke writing and eccentric family dynamics, appealing to fans of Community.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy packed with nerdy references and lighthearted space adventures, perfect for Futurama and Rick and Morty fans.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: An incredibly uplifting and funny sitcom with a heartwarming redemption arc and lovable characters, carrying the feel-good energy of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A comforting, wholesome mockumentary sitcom with sharp writing and a wonderful ensemble that is easy to watch and highly uplifting.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: An incredibly comforting, hilarious UK comedy game show where comedians complete absurd tasks. A perfect companion to Gogglebox.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A lighthearted, comforting pirate comedy featuring historical adventure, quirky characters, and sweet romantic elements.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy-drama that captures the optimistic spirit, episodic adventure, and lighthearted fun of Doctor Who and Futurama.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A warm, witty, and heartwarming supernatural sitcom about a couple living with historical ghosts, sharing the cozy energy of The Good Place.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: An underrated, ultra-fast-paced ensemble sitcom that matches the witty chemistry and quick-fire jokes of New Girl.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: An incredibly wholesome and absurdly funny buddy comedy about two best friends, capturing the pure joy and positive vibes of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Lovesick
metas.description: A sweet, funny, and comforting British romantic comedy-drama with excellent music and a great central friend group.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A chaotic, hilarious female-led buddy comedy that captures the wild, free-wheeling spirit of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the minds behind Ted Lasso and Scrubs, this comedy-drama is comforting, witty, and deals with life's hurdles with a smile.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliantly written animated sci-fi/action parody that appeals directly to fans of Futurama's worldbuilding and Rick and Morty's wit.

metas.name: Acapulco
metas.description: A bright, colorful, and incredibly heartwarming bilingual comedy series with strong themes of family and ambition in a tropical resort setting.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: An inventive and fast-paced corporate satire with highly creative humor, making it a great match for fans of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Father Ted
metas.description: A classic, surreal, and incredibly lighthearted Irish sitcom about three exiled priests on a remote island, offering top-tier comfort comedy.

metas.name: Plebs
metas.description: A hilarious modern-style British sitcom set in Ancient Rome, matching the lad-comedy vibe of PhoneShop and Brassic.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: An action-packed, hilariously irreverent comic book adventure with a surprising amount of heart, matching the energy of One-Punch Man.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: A fast-paced, witty animated spy comedy with snappy dialogue and running gags that fans of Futurama's workplace humor will enjoy.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: A brilliant UK university sitcom co-created by the writers of Peep Show, featuring great character dynamics and sharp observational humor.

metas.name: This Country
metas.description: A highly acclaimed, dry mockumentary about rural UK life with the brilliant, quiet comedic awkwardness found in Peep Show.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult comedy about a cynical catering crew chasing Hollywood dreams, boasting a fantastic cast similar to Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A warm, lighthearted, and funny family sitcom with cozy dynamics that is incredibly easy to put on in the background.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Scrubs, this sitcom quickly evolved into a deeply comforting, goofy show about a close friend group who love wine.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: The ultimate high-quality, easy-watching mockumentary that serves as great background viewing, sharing vibes with Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A blisteringly fast-paced and highly-rated political satire with incredibly sharp insults and cynical humor perfect for Silicon Valley fans.

metas.name: Catastrophe
metas.description: A wonderfully witty, honest, and hilariously sharp comedy-drama about relationships, perfect for fans of Master of None.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: A goofy, highly-reeling workplace buddy comedy that captures the chaotic, juvenile friend-group dynamic of It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A deadpan, quirky musical comedy about two New Zealanders in New York, capturing a delightfully awkward energy like Peep Show.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A hilarious sci-fi comedy about an awkward alien trying to blend into a small town, matching the quirky sci-fi vibes of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Ted
metas.description: A lighthearted prequel comedy series about the foul-mouthed teddy bear, carrying a nostalgic, warm 90s family sitcom format.
